name: Traffic Light
source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="red">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="cycles" expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="red">
    <onentry><assign location="cycles" expr="cycles + 1"/></onentry>
    <transition event="next" target="green"/>
  </state>
  <state id="green">
    <transition event="next" target="yellow"/>
  </state>
  <state id="yellow">
    <transition event="next" target="red"/>
  </state>
</scxml>
